review: Request: at round 38 Lin (health 100, satiety 85.8, energy 39.4, beside commons-root-0-0 in the dark, owning two berry stacks, having mastered examine-material@1 and holding three records: the round-37 traits of unit 1 in place, the round-32 unverified visible state of the source and a round-25 berry eating record) asked whether an accessible food specimen can be assessed for toxicity, edibility and preparation without eating it, separating tested findings from appearance, hearsay and unknowns, and reporting the limitation and unmet prerequisites if no valid non-ingestive method exists. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) assess-food-evidence(target, specimen, mode, evidenceRefs, methodRef?, equipmentRefs?, quantity?) with modes assess and execute-validated-method sharing one evidence pipeline. Whether a validated non-ingestive protocol exists here: no. The installed capabilities are the forest, open and expression foundations, prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1, construct-weather-shelter@1, examine-material@1 and length-reference@1; examine-material records qualitative traits and calibrated dimensions, probe observe records visible state and its press, wet and heat trials consume material to test load, water or heat response, consult reads records, and eat is ingestion, so none tests a food hazard or preparation claim with detection limits, controls, hazards and disposal. Implemented (full specified scope, not a first release): assess-food-evidence@1 (ability and handler long.assess-food-evidence, equivalence food:specimen-evidence:non-ingestive-assessment:1, learning 2 at 0.2 energy per study round, 2.9 thousand code units, registered last, no visual component, no satisfaction source, one event food-evidence-assessed). assess: 1 round and 0.2 energy; target and specimen are examine-material@1's specimen (own item, loose item in reach or one unit in place in a source, not reserved, not under a hazard); evidenceRefs are at most four exact ids of complete records the person holds (a personal record key or its evidence event id, an eating record, a heard message id, or an earlier assessment); methodRef must be an installed capability or the person's record; equipmentRefs must be own items, loose items in reach or objects in reach; quantity is above 0 and at most one unit and is only recorded. Every malformed or inaccessible input, an unresolved reference, a paged fragment or undated record, a free-text method, too little energy or no study is refused before payment; an accessible specimen with no valid evidence or method is a paid assessment that yields the limitation report. It writes an unverified personal record (key target:unit-N:food-evidence, readable with consult) and an event with actor, target, unit, round and time, every cited id with its version (round, evidence event, content digest), the candidate protocol, equipment, conditions, applicability and currency checks, provenance (consult and probe of foundation-open@1, examine-material by its equivalence, as separate actions) and limitations. Direct observations (own unverified records of this target and unit, with their seen traits), validated findings (verified records about the same material, each scoped to its tested property and addressing no food question), unverified claims (the shown name of the target, visible signs about it, heard messages, records received from others) and unknowns (identity, the three questions, traits not seen when recorded, other units) are kept separate, and records about another material, source or unit, earlier assessments and stale records are listed as not applicable. Toxicity, edibility and preparation are reported independently, each unknown and unsupported with no claim, method, detection limit or uncertainty, and with what would support it; the conclusion is the specified one: no validated non-ingestive method established among supplied accessible evidence; toxicity, edibility and preparation requirements remain unknown, with absence of a result not a negative result and no claim that such a method cannot exist. The unmet requirements use the ex21 bill states: identification reference and validated protocol missing; equipment, controls, materials and safe conditions unestablished (set only by a validated method record); light missing in the dark; a calibrated balance missing for any measured-sample protocol. In the dark no new visual identification is made and earlier observations are cited as recorded, never as newly seen. execute-validated-method runs the same checks, then is refused before any cost, naming the candidate, the missing validated protocol, the number of installed capabilities checked and the nearest ones, and the unmet list; no sample, reagent or equipment is committed. Event view metadata: operation, mode, actor, target, unit, setting, status inconclusive, progress, rounds, evidence refs, method, conditions, result unknown, uncertainty, limitation codes dark and missing-method, prior observations, newlySeen empty, badge, assay, tools, reagents and samples empty or null, position and evidence; no safe-food badge, assay or preparation effect. What Lin can do now: study for 2 rounds (0.4 energy), then for 0.2 energy assess commons-root-0-0 unit 1 citing commons-root-0-0:unit-1:traits, commons-root-0-0:observed-state and berry, and learn that both root records are current direct observations of appearance and source condition only, the berry record concerns berries only, the shown name is a label, and toxicity, edibility and preparation stay unknown with the listed missing identification reference and protocol; execute-validated-method is refused at no cost. A throwaway check on the archived round-38 world, in memory only, did exactly this: mastered after two study rounds, assessed at round 40 for 0.2 energy with the source stock unchanged at 20, and the run mode was refused at no cost with 22 other installed capabilities checked. Assumptions: (1) any accessible material specimen is accepted, because deciding that it is food is itself an edibility judgment, and no nutrition, toxicity or food classification is read; (2) a complete record is an exact whole record the person holds, dated no later than now and not a paged fragment, and equipment ids keep the ex21 12-id bound; (3) the classification rules above, with an eating record of the same material counted as a direct observation of an eaten unit, not of this specimen; (4) a cited examine-material record is current while examine-material@1's logged unit-record digest equals the current one (for a source unit its id, material and stock; for an item its represented record, compared only and never shown), a probe visible-state record while the source stock and stage are unchanged, other records are unchecked, stale ones do not apply, and nothing is revalidated automatically; (5) a question can be supported only by a validated non-ingestive protocol, none is implemented, so every finding is unknown and the status inconclusive; (6) a validated protocol must be its own implemented, reviewed mechanism declaring its tested claim, prerequisites, costs, detection limits, controls, hazards and disposal, and running one needs a later revision, so this mode is a gate that refuses before cost; (7) the assessment is atomic in one round with nothing pending, reserved or held, refusals emit no event, so only completed inconclusive assessments are drawn and pending, interrupted and blocked are never emitted; (8) one personal record per unit holds the latest assessment while a 16-entry log keeps the others, and newFinding is false when the same unit state, cited versions and method repeat. No reward: the review's bounded award proposal was not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards; the record is unverified and the event never carries a qualified flag. Reuse: ex21 targeted-food-constituent-test@1 code (its exact id-list and bounded-text parsers, the supplied-object classification and the requirement-bill row type, set-by-method basis and balance row) through an additive export block at the end of its file; examine-material@1's specimen resolution, unit-record digest, record digest and examination log through one added export; shelterMeasure of construct-weather-shelter@1; openRemember of foundation-open@1; expressionSign and the heard list of the expression foundation, read only; ex19MaterialDark and forestClimate; length-reference@1's observed, unsupported and unknown classes as the record format. consult, probe and examine-material are not called; their own costs apply when used. No existing package changed: the test asserts one digest over all 122 previously registered packages (validation-results/scratch/ex24/hashes-before-5.json, taken before this change) and the individual hashes of foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, targeted-food-constituent-test@1, construct-weather-shelter@1, examine-material@1 and length-reference@1. Narrowed: the length-reference@1 test now checks that its package is the fourth ex24 package and that the scope's first four packages are the rack, the shelter, the examination and the length reference, instead of registered last with an exact set. Checks: pnpm typecheck, eslint with no warnings and prettier on the six changed files, this test (8 tests), the two long-run scenario tests and every test of experiments 19 to 24 (25 files, 242 tests) passed.
